segments.text: So what kind of mindset do you have to have to be successful at SoCal Contractor Exchange?
First and foremost, you have to have a winning, hungry, go-getter attitude, right? It's a mindset
of every single day is a new day, full of new opportunities. It's crazy to see there's guys
that work the same amount of hours, same location, and they have dramatically different paychecks.
You know, one guy has a couple hundred bucks, guy has several thousand dollars. So the attitude
to be successful here is one that requires deposits every single day. You got to be willing to grow.
You got to be willing to, you know, improve your mind, improve your health, improve every single
part of your body, you know, because it's all connected. It's not just one thing.
